build_fused_semantic_head: build a FusedSemanticHead module for multi-level fused semantic segmentation with configurable convolution layers
create_fused_semantic_head_instance: create a FusedSemanticHead instance with num_ins levels, fusion_level, and 256 input channels
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass on multi-level feature maps through the FusedSemanticHead to get mask predictions
compute_semantic_seg_loss: compute the weighted cross-entropy loss for semantic segmentation predictions against ground truth labels
init_conv_logits_weights: initialize the conv_logits layer weights using Kaiming initialization in FusedSemanticHead
